skill.name: testing-test-writing
skill.description: Write minimal, focused tests for core user flows and critical paths during development, testing behavior rather than implementation with clear test names and mocked dependencies. Use this skill when writing unit tests, integration tests, test files, test cases for critical workflows, or mocking external dependencies. Apply when working with test files (.test.js, .spec.ts, _test.py), test frameworks (Jest, RSpec, pytest), testing user journeys, or implementing fast-executing tests that validate business-critical functionality without over-testing implementation details or edge cases during feature development.
skill.summary: Guides AI assistants to write focused behavior tests for critical workflows and external dependencies.

content.user_title: Write Focused Tests for Critical Workflows
content.value_statement: Feature work needs tests that protect important behavior without slowing development. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to write focused, behavior-driven tests.
actual_capabilities: Guide unit and integration test creation for new features.
Focus tests on core user flows and critical business paths.
Promote clear test names and behavior-focused assertions.
Recommend mocks for APIs, databases, and file systems.
Support common frameworks including Jest, Mocha, RSpec, pytest, and JUnit.
Encourage fast unit tests and strategic coverage choices.
limitations: Does not include executable test helpers or framework adapters.
Relies on external standards guidance referenced outside the packaged skill.
Does not aim to test every edge case during feature development.
Requires project code, test conventions, and expected behavior from the user.

use_cases.title: Add Tests for a New Feature
use_cases.description: Create focused tests that cover the main user workflow and important failure behavior.

use_cases.title: Improve Existing Test Quality
use_cases.description: Refactor brittle tests toward behavior checks with clear names and useful mocks.

use_cases.title: Review Critical Path Coverage
use_cases.description: Identify missing tests for high-value workflows before a release or merge.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Unit Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small function or component.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write focused unit tests for this code. Cover the primary behavior, use clear test names, and avoid testing implementation details.

prompt_templates.title: Test a User Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a feature path.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add tests for this user workflow. Prioritize the successful path, one important failure path, and the observable behavior users rely on.

prompt_templates.title: Mock External Dependencies
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request involving APIs, databases, or file systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Write tests for this feature while mocking external dependencies. Keep mocks minimal and assert the behavior that matters to the user.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Test Coverage Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request before a release or large merge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feature and existing tests. Identify the smallest useful test set for critical workflows, risky branches, and regression protection.

output_examples.input: A checkout feature needs tests before merge.
output: A short list of checkout behaviors that need coverage.
Recommended unit and integration test names.
Mocking guidance for payment and inventory dependencies.

output_examples.input: A service has brittle tests tied to private methods.
output: Clearer test names based on user-visible outcomes.
Advice on removing unnecessary implementation assertions.

output_examples.input: A bug fix needs regression coverage.
output: Expected behavior before and after the fix.
Notes on keeping the test fast and maintainable.

best_practices: Start with the highest-value user flow before adding secondary cases.
Name tests by expected behavior, not internal implementation.
Mock external services only at the boundary needed for stable tests.
anti_patterns: Writing tests that duplicate private implementation details.
Mocking so much behavior that the test no longer checks the feature.
Adding broad edge-case suites before critical paths are covered.

faq.question: What kinds of tests does this skill help write?
faq.answer: It helps write unit tests, integration tests, and workflow tests for important product behavior.

faq.question: Which test frameworks are mentioned?
faq.answer: The skill mentions Jest, Mocha, RSpec, pytest, and JUnit as relevant frameworks.

faq.question: Does it focus on implementation details?
faq.answer: No. It guides the assistant to test observable behavior instead of private implementation details.

faq.question: Can it help with mocks?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers mocking external dependencies such as APIs, databases, and file systems.

faq.question: Is it useful during feature development?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed for adding strategic tests while implementing or finishing a feature.

faq.question: Does the package include all referenced guidance?
faq.answer: No. The skill currently links to guidance outside the packaged skill directory.
